column_description: Primary key (VARCHAR(20)) for an operation record (previously 'OperationRegistry').
VARCHAR(20) referencing robot_details(BotDetReg). Links this operation record to a specific robot’s details.
VARCHAR(20) referencing robot_record(RecReg), tying the operation to the main robot record.
DECIMAL(9,2) capturing total operating hours for the robot in this operation context.
VARCHAR(40) describing the application type (e.g., 'Assembly', 'Painting', 'Palletizing', 'Material Handling', 'Welding').
VARCHAR(40) naming the current program loaded or running on the robot.
INT counting how many times the program cycle has executed.
DECIMAL(8,3) measuring cycle time in seconds (precision to three decimals).
SMALLINT storing how many axes (joints) the robot uses in this operation environment (e.g., 7, 6, 5, 4).
